overnightRisk: Next report is ~02:00 COT, and the weekend follows (US equity ETFs closed Sat-Sun, thinner liquidity). Longs are crowded (OKX 1H long/short account ratio 1.82, funding +0.01%), so a break under 80,800 can cascade to 80,228 and the 79,775 Oct 14 low; the 25x long-liquidation bracket sits near 78.4k (estimate). Catalysts: QQQ fell 2.5% on Oct 16 to a month low (risk-off spill-over), Brent near 109.9 and US10Y 5.08% keep macro pressure on, and Farside shows spot BTC ETF flows flat (0.0 Oct 16). A resting stop at 80,200 is the only protection while nobody is watching.
